name: karviyam-root
description: Karviyam E-Commerce Web Application Root Workspace

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')){ fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'backend/dist', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('frontend/dist/index.html', 'index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist/assets')){ fs.cpSync('frontend/dist/assets', 'assets', {recursive: true}); } }"
